# Studypool

> > Studypool is a 24/7 verified tutor marketplace connecting students with academic help across homework, tutoring solutions, and comprehensive study guides.

Studypool provides on-demand homework help and tutoring services from verified educators, supplemented by an extensive library of study guides for literature and academic subjects. The platform serves students across multiple disciplines including accounting, communications, and programming languages.
